identify_intro.title: Start Here
identify_intro.body: This is a reef puzzle game. First, pick at least one species you can recognise in the image.

goal_intro.title: Your Goal
goal_intro.body: Now rebuild the target reef. Match the objective before you run out of turns.

feed_action.title: Add Fish
feed_action.body: Tap + on a fish card to add one fish. Feeding costs Nutrients.

end_turn_action.title: Resolve The Reef
end_turn_action.body: Press End Turn to see how your reef changes.

results_intro.title: Read The Results
results_intro.body: This panel compares your current reef against the target. Press Continue to keep solving.

win_outro.title: That Is The Loop
win_outro.body: Identify, adjust the reef, end the turn, and compare the result. The rest of the levels build on that.
